answer: A velvet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a precise technical wording, minimal adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
